title: The 5 AM Club Discovers the Habit Installation Protocol
coreMove: Habit installation becomes realistic when old-pattern destruction, new-behavior practice, and integration are expected before automaticity arrives.

exampleSpecs.stakes: old cues can look like proof the habit is impossible
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use first 22 days as destruction of old pattern

exampleSpecs.audience: people discouraged after the first month
exampleSpecs.stakes: the middle phase can feel like failure because ease has not arrived
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show second 22 days as new behavior present but not easy

exampleSpecs.stakes: overconfidence can break integration before automaticity stabilizes

exampleSpecs.audience: writers applying the protocol beyond waking
exampleSpecs.stakes: other behaviors also need installation rather than mood
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the protocol applying to other behaviors

exampleSpecs.audience: people counting days without changing systems
exampleSpecs.stakes: a number can hide poor design

exampleSpecs.audience: students quitting when discipline feels bad
exampleSpecs.stakes: discomfort can be misread as a sign that the student is not suited for the habit
